1. CASUAL LEAVE
Every employee is entitled to 12 days of casual leave per calendar year.
Casual leave cannot be carried forward to the next year.
A maximum of 3 casual leave days can be taken consecutively.
Casual leave must be applied for at least 1 day in advance, except in emergencies.

The company observes 12 public holidays per year.

32f50442-b801-4fc6-9e40-13c6cd63f494.text:
2. SICK LEAVE
Every employee is entitled to 10 days of paid sick leave per year.
A medical certificate is required if sick leave exceeds 2 consecutive days.
Unused sick leave can be carried forward up to a maximum of 15 days in total.

7a433420-19ae-4faf-93b5-86845c0ff52e.text:
3. EARNED (PRIVILEGE) LEAVE
Employees earn 1.5 days of earned leave per month, which is 18 days per year.
Earned leave can be carried forward up to a maximum of 30 days.
Earned leave must be applied for at least 7 days in advance.
Employees must complete 6 months of service before using earned leave.

46533683-b0ba-499f-82d3-38f139cef6d5.text:
4. MATERNITY LEAVE
Female employees are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave.
Maternity leave can start up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery date.
Employees must have worked at least 80 days in the 12 months before delivery.
